value.rationale: A natural negative-Dirichlet orthogonal-polynomial recurrence has a quantifiably infinite exterior spectrum with complete leading count and eigenvalue-edge law. Sharp constant for every fixed exponent is useful to distinguish the all-level tail from the unresolved leading eigenvalue, and to calibrate truncation/asymptotic spectral computations. The object and precise edge invariant are motivated by the cited original Jacobi question, not selected after arbitrary parameter slicing.
